Sam: Quick sync — Nimbus POC: need to lock top 3 user journeys, prompts/evals, timeline. @Anya @Leo can you confirm available scope? :rocket:
Anya: Yep, can do. Proposed journeys: 1) in-app summarization of support threads 2) guided form autofill for claims 3) context-aware FAQ answers. Leaning towards 1+3 for MVP.
Leo: Agree 1+3. Which endpoints are required? We should define expected QPS/latency.
Sam: MVP endpoints ->
```
POST /v1/generate-chat   (system + user messages)
POST /v1/embeddings      (doc search indexing)
POST /v1/rerank          (optional, for top-k precision)
```
Sam: Target latency <500ms p50 for chat, embeddings can be async. QPS estimate: 20 peak (per customer).
Marcus: On pricing — prospect wants a committed monthly cap; need rough cost estimate (tokens/month) from engineering.
Priya: I'll profile prompts once we settle examples. Who owns the prompt bank?
Anya: I'll draft prompts. Need 10 seed prompts per journey + eval set (50 queries).
Priya: For evals — propose automated metrics (BLEU/ROUGE) + human spot-check on 20 samples. Use eval-bot to run baseline.
Diane: Security asks: SOC2 attestation, data residency (EU), encryption at rest + in transit. We'll offer VPC + KMS. Also need confirmation on retention and redaction.
Jin: Ops note: if we enable prefix/KV caching, pass `x-client-id` header for per-tenant cache keys. Also will need rate-limit policy: 100 rps burst -> throttle.
Sam: Success criteria (working draft): 1) accuracy >= 85% on intent classification for FAQ flow; 2) p50 chat latency <500ms; 3) no PII persisted in logs; 4) rolling deploy with canary + 24h rollback window.
Marcus: Timeline suggestion: kickoff this week, prompts + evals by EOW, internal demo next Thu, pilot run with customer in 3 weeks.
Anya: I'll post the prompt spreadsheet and eval templates here by EOD. @Sam please ping if anything blocks.
Sam: Owners: prompts -> Anya, evals -> Priya, security -> Diane, infra -> Jin, pricing -> Marcus. I'll follow up with calendar invites.
eval-bot: baseline eval run scheduled for 1779990300, results will be posted to #poc-results.
Sam: ✅ closing loop. Any blockers?
Marcus: Sales/legal needs an example contract clause for data handling / retention limits. Diane, can you share a template?
Diane: Yes — will upload a redacted template and SQA answers in ~1h. :lock: 
Sam: Great — thanks everyone. Will update the deck with success criteria and share before the internal demo.
